assertion.statement: The two-adic completion of the actual local elliptic group has free Z2 rank d_w and finite two-primary torsion with exactly two generators; derived reduction of the old Kummer condition has dimensions (2,2+d_w).
assertion.objects: E^(h)(K_w)^completed_2 and its old Kummer local condition, with rational full E^(h)[2].
assertion.hypotheses: K_w is a finite extension of Q_p. d_w=[K_w:Q2] if p=2 and zero otherwise. The actual full two-torsion is rational. The local condition is the retained derived Kummer condition, not just its H1 image.
assertion.quantifiers: Each old Kummer place in the current construction.
assertion.uniformity: Exact rank and mod2 dimensions at each fixed place; no uniform torsion exponent.
assertion.constants: Dimensions are2 in degree0 and2+d_w in degree1.
assertion.normalizations: Two-adic completion, followed by derived tensor with F2; torsion is retained.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion that the finite-index formal subgroup equals the whole group. No deletion of degree-zero torsion.
assertion.limit_order: Use the finite-index local structure, take the two-primary completion, identify its finite torsion generators via rational E[2], then apply derived reduction.

use.reason: Supplies the local group structure before the existing completion and derived reduction calculation.
